title: Linkage
description: Represents a message asserting a linkage between specific assets.

linked_asset_id.description: The asset or primary key representing what asset is linked with the primary header asset.

linked_asset_kind.description: A valid Asset Kind code that specifies the precise type of asset is linked with the primary header asset.

linked_system_id.description: A valid CSNR IT Service Management identifying the originating source system, service, or asset.

relation_kind.description: The kind of relation between the primary asset and the linked asset (for example, MERGES, RELATES, SELF, SPLITS).
